Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Pod `uploads-8647dc6f95-x7gsv` in namespace `shop` (container `uploads`, ReplicaSet `uploads-8647dc6f95`) fills the 64Mi PVC `uploads-data` by writing a 200 MiB file (`dd ... count=200`) into `/data`, so the write fails with "No space left on device".

EVIDENCE:
1. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop pvc uploads-data`: Status Bound, Capacity 64Mi, StorageClass lab-local, Volume lab-uploads, Used By uploads-8647dc6f95-x7gsv, Access Modes RWO.
2. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe pv lab-uploads`: StorageClass lab-local, Reclaim Policy Retain, Source LocalVolume at /mnt/lab-uploads, Node Affinity sre-lab-worker2, Capacity 64Mi.
3. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe storageclass lab-local`: Provisioner kubernetes.io/no-provisioner, AllowVolumeExpansion unset (the claim cannot be expanded), VolumeBindingMode WaitForFirstConsumer.
4. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop pod uploads-8647dc6f95-x7gsv`: command `sh -c "echo uploads: writing; dd if=/dev/zero of=/data/uploads.bin bs=1M count=200; echo uploads: write failed; df -h /data; sleep 36000"`, mounted at /data from claim uploads-data, Restart Count 0, Ready True.
5. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab logs -n shop uploads-8647dc6f95-x7gsv` (verified by me): `dd: error writing '/data/uploads.bin': No space left on device`, `64+0 records out`, `67108864 bytes (64.0MB) copied`, `uploads: write failed`, then `tmpfs 64.0M 64.0M 0 100% /data`.
6. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop pvc uploads-data` (verified by me): StorageClass lab-local, Status Bound, Capacity 64Mi, Used By uploads-8647dc6f95-x7gsv, matching diag-k8s's values.

FIX (not applied): Change the uploads Deployment's command so it stops writing 200 MiB into the 64Mi claim (or move uploads to a larger volume, since StorageClass lab-local does not allow expansion of the existing claim).

Fact.Name: cause
Fact.Value: the `uploads` container wrote `uploads.bin` with `dd` until `No space left on device`

Fact.Name: volume
Fact.Value: PV `lab-uploads`, StorageClass `lab-local` (no provisioner: it cannot be expanded)

Fact.Name: fix (not applied)
Fact.Value: free space or move to a larger volume; expansion is not possible with this class
